spans.s: सृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Let loose; 2. poured out; 3. created; 4. abandoned; 5. ornamented; 6. abundant, much; 7. determined; 8. connected, joined, (pp. of सृज् q.v.).
सृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Let loose; 2. poured out; 3. created; 4. abandoned; 5. ornamented; 6. abundant, much; 7. determined; 8. connected, joined, (pp. of सृज् q.v.).

सृष्टि f. 1. Creation, या तत्र स्याद्युवतिविषये सृष्टिराद्येव धातुः Megh.ii.19, या सृष्टिः स्रष्टुराद्या Sak.i., R.vi.37; 2. the creation of the world; 3. giving away, gift; 4. emission, letting loose; 5. nature, natural property or disposition; 6. the existence of properties; 7. the absence of properties.
